items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stanley Clark, the bassist, teaches somewhere at a school or conservatory or university—a jazz class. And Stevie went, and they played.

ctx.x: Well, even Stevie Wonder… I mean, he…

Oh, Stevie, yes. He’s the most… Oh, Stevie… He’s not enough considered as a harmonica player. They say, “Oh yeah, he writes every [unintelligible].” He’s a great composer, a showman. He sings [unintelligible]. But I can tell you what he plays… You listen to the YouTube again when he plays… plays Alfie with Burt Bacharach. [inaudible]. I have it on my… but I can’t show it to you. There is no signal here. I [had thought?] that he played… I heard him. He was as a guest sometimes as a… Stanley Clark, the bassist,…
